info.title: Currency Historical Data Limits API Reference
info.description: Retrieve the date range for which historical exchange rate data is available for each supported currency. Returns a map of currency codes to their availability period in YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD format. Covers fiat currencies, cryptocurrencies, and precious metals.

servers.description: Currency Historical Data Limits API Server

get.description: Returns the date range when historical data is available for each currency.

406.description: Unsupported Media Type — format is not json or xml

value.message: The media type specified in the request is not supported. For more details, please refer to the API documentation.

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

availabilityPeriod.description: Map of currency codes to their historical data availability range. Each key is a currency code and the value is a date range string.

additionalProperties.title: AvailabilityPeriodString
additionalProperties.description: Historical data availability date range in YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD format.

HistoricalDataLimitsResponse.description: Historical data limits response containing the availability period map.
